en: Black-and-white postcard view of a grand, two‑storey railway station building with a central clock tower and arched windows. The foreground shows tram tracks, a cobblestone square, several pedestrians, bicycles lined up along the facade, and mid‑20th‑century cars. The caption at the bottom left reads "NORRKÖPING. Centralstationen" and there is a small publisher's logo and number in the lower right corner.
